messages:
marta: quick flag — packaging flagged an out-of-sync cosign timestamp on private-offline-installer:v1.22.0-rc3. not yet blocking, but we shouldn’t proceed without a plan.

sam: short list for decision: a) re-sign and wait for mirror propagation, b) delay cutover 20m, c) manual canary override to skip canary if we accept risk. which do we want?

jihoon: technical detail: signer C shows a 7m clock skew vs HSM. verification fails on strict validators. re-signing via KMS should resolve; expect ~5-8m plus mirror sync.

tanya: deploy-bot has a scheduled canary at 03:30 UTC. if we reissue, deploy-bot will auto-cancel the current window. we can set a manual hold to resume once verified.

andrew: +1 to re-sign. i don't want to skip canary. set rollback policy to v1.21.9 and reduce canary window to 15m after start so we limit blast radius.

luke: ops suggestion: update release metadata with a note about the reissue and add KMS audit link. also pin the shrinkwrap manifest to the RC.

sam: drafting the rollback triggers: error rate > 2% for 4m OR median latency increase > 30% vs baseline -> rollback. adding manual approval gate at 12m so we can abort automated rollback if re-sign completes.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Received: private/vpc-installer v1.22.0-rc3 by @marta. Canary group=staging-airgap-7. Scheduled window=03:30-04:00 UTC. Auto-rollback on failure thresholds as specified. Manual gates allowed.

sam: paste re-sign command for oncall:
```bash
cosign sign-blob --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/releases/keys/release-key \
  gs://staging-bucket/private-offline-installer-v1.22.0-rc3.tar.gz.sig
```

jihoon: starting re-sign now. tagging @tanya @luke for mirror verification.

(7m later)

jihoon: re-sign finished. cosign verify: PASS. however mirror-2 shows a checksum mismatch for the signed blob. investigating propagation lag.

tanya: mirror-2 prober shows old artifact present. kicking mirror sync job and invalidating CDN edge cache for the manifest. estimated extra 6m.

andrew: if mirror sync doesn't finish before the original canary start, flip canary to start +20m. we don't want partial mirrors.

sam: i've updated deploy-bot to delay start by 20m. new window 03:50-04:05 UTC (15m box). deploy-bot confirm?

deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary window updated to 03:50-04:05 UTC. Monitor hooks: traces, success-rate, token-cost. Rollback to v1.21.9 on triggers.

jihoon: mirror-2 now matches checksum: sha256=ab12cdef34... MD5=a1b2c3d4. manual verification done by @tanya.

marta: great. proceeding with canary at 03:50. small note for release-notes: mention short delay for signer reissue + mirror resync.

luke: also adding a packaging-runbook note about clock skew detection and a quick re-sign checklist. saves oncall time next time.

andrew: postmortem note: consider adding signing TTL enforcement in CI to fail earlier.

sam: updating release-notes PR and pushing pin to `private-pins/rc3/pins.json`. leaving a line: "Delay: 20m due to signer reissue and mirror sync; canary passed; no rollback."

marta: thanks team. closing thread after PR merges and deploy-bot reports canary success. :white_check_mark:
